comment: save.c savelev_core() writes svu.updest and svd.dndest for the hero's level, and restore.c getlev() reads them back. The first segment level-teleports into the Valley of the Dead, whose valley.lua teleport regions set both areas, and saves there. After the restore, ^V5 builds a new Dlvl 5, which saves the Valley with the restored areas, and ^V45 returns to the Valley: u_on_rndspot() places the hero with place_lregion() inside the Valley's down-teleport region instead of anywhere on the map.
